description: B-vs-C experiment: bisection vs gradient-guided correction for DripTray size-z. Measures the informational value of the sensitivity edge (∂displacement/∂size-z = −0.008018 mm/mm measured 2026-08-04). 5 tasks spanning corrections from 0.7 mm to 7.7 mm.

safeHeightDomainMm.rationale: Selection boxes (z = ±16 mm) require heightMm/2 < 16 mm to maintain face margin. At 31 mm the margin is 0.5 mm (validated by the sensitivity case). At 32 mm the margin is 0, reproducing the R2 selection-box failure.

tasks.designNote: Small correction ≈0.7 mm expected. u(29mm) ≈ 0.093 mm (linear estimate from measured derivative).
Medium correction ≈1.3 mm expected. u(28mm) ≈ 0.101 mm.
Medium-large correction ≈2.0 mm expected. u(27mm) ≈ 0.109 mm.
Large correction ≈3.1 mm expected. u(25mm) ≈ 0.125 mm.
Very large correction ≈3.9 mm expected. u(23mm) ≈ 0.141 mm. Tests domain extrapolation of measured derivative.

ceilingDisplacementMm.provenance: Measured at heightMm=31 by the 2026-08-04 sensitivity study (stepped run), CalculiX live, R3 selection boxes. A task threshold at or below this value has no solution inside the safe domain; the loader must reject it.
